intent: Create the user-authorized Japan ball-on-the-line Short with a clear visual reveal and advanced basic stick-figure motion.
method: Verified FIFA match account, official goal page, broadcaster photo analysis and IFAB rule; establish a short action-first treatment and geometric demonstration.
result: Saved 32-second treatment. Final quality requires visual review; world-class is a target, not a self-awarded status.

intent: Test visual comprehension before the final render.
method: Inspected 19 representative native frames, then full-size frozen contact, macro reveal and finishing pose. Preserved the initial layout.
result: Corrected the hand near the ball, low-contrast macro scene, annotation shadows, faceted panels, conflicting visibility groups, finish framing and sprint foot drift. The later visual reveal clearly exposes an overlapping cap; user comprehension remains to be tested.

intent: Verify contact and the meaning of the visual rule demonstration.
method: Evaluate the saved native scene: boot and knee surface contact, hand clearance, sprint plants, a stationary macro sphere under a moving camera, and all displayed in/out states.
result: 192 original limb drivers valid; two sprint plant intervals have zero measured drift; contact checks passed. Sphere fixed for 240 checked frames; 185 state-label frames agree with sphere/line geometry. Original character file unchanged. Sampled visual review passed; final export and user acceptance remain pending.

intent: Support the action and visual reveal without narration.
method: Reused synthesis helpers for an original score, designed atmosphere and 28 timed Foley cues; performed measured two-pass normalization.
result: 32-second stereo soundtrack created and embedded in the editable project. No speech, source recording or voice clone. Export levels and subjective listening acceptance remain separate checks.

intent: Render the complete corrected picture at delivery resolution.
method: Blender EEVEE rendered 768 native frames and streamed them to FFmpeg H.264.
result: 32 seconds at 1080x1920 and 24 fps. Render completed successfully.

intent: Deliver the authorized Japan line-puzzle animation, editable assets and production record.
method: Muxed native picture with the original normalized soundtrack. Verified full decode, 768 frames, dimensions, duration and audio levels; inspected decoded chase and finish sequences and full-size exported in/out frames.
result: Complete 32-second vertical Short, no narration; final audio -15.77 LUFS integrated and -1.74 dBTP true peak. Rule illustration and condensed match action are distinguished. Technical checks passed; sampled visual review completed. Audience comprehension, subjective sound acceptance and world-class status are not established.
decision: Ready for user viewing. Final creative acceptance pending; no publication requested or performed.
